items.title: Iran-Oman discuss Hormuz Reopening | Brent at $86 | Nvidia earnings today
items.description: Global markets are signalling a positive start for Indian equities after Wall Street closed higher on Tuesday, with the Dow Jones, S&P 500 and Nasdaq gaining around 0.3-0.7%, led by a rebound in technology and semiconductor stocks ahead of Nvidia’s earnings. U.S. Treasury yields eased as crude oil prices declined, with Brent slipping below $90 a barrel, offering some relief on inflation concerns. Investors remain focused on Nvidia’s results and the upcoming July PCE inflation data for cues on the U.S. rate outlook. Asian markets are trading mixed this morning, while GIFT Nifty points to a positive opening for Indian benchmarks. Geopolitical developments around the Strait of Hormuz and U.S.-Iran tensions remain key factors for market sentiment, with falling oil prices currently providing some support. Gold is marginally lower. Overall, traders will track global cues, crude prices, Nvidia’s earnings and domestic expiry-related volatility through the session.
